get.description: Searches activities using the supplied filters and returns matching paginated activity summaries.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero-based offset of the first activity to return. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of activities to return. Defaults to 99.

parameters.name: favorite
parameters.description: Filter by favorite status: 1 returns favorites, 0 returns non-favorites, and -1 applies no favorite filter. Defaults to -1.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction: asc for ascending or desc for descending, case-insensitive. Defaults to desc.

parameters.name: excludeChildren
parameters.description: Whether to exclude child activities that have a parent activity, such as individual legs of a multisport activity. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Activity field to sort by, such as name, distance, or duration. Defaults to startLocal, the activity's local start date and time.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text to search for in activity names and descriptions.

parameters.name: activityType
parameters.description: Parent activity type key to include, such as running or cycling. Must identify a parent type, not a subtype.

parameters.name: activitySubType
parameters.description: Activity subtype key to include. Must identify a child type and, if activityType is also provided, belong to that parent type. For example, use activitySubType=trail_running with activityType=running, or activitySubType=road_cycling with activityType=cycling.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: Event classification key to include, such as race, training, recreation, fitness, specialEvent, or uncategorized.

parameters.name: minDistance
parameters.description: Inclusive minimum activity distance, in meters.

parameters.name: maxDistance
parameters.description: Inclusive maximum activity distance, in meters.

parameters.name: minDuration
parameters.description: Inclusive minimum activity timer duration, in seconds.

parameters.name: maxDuration
parameters.description: Inclusive maximum activity timer duration, in seconds.

parameters.name: minElevation
parameters.description: Inclusive minimum total elevation gain for the activity, in meters.

parameters.name: maxElevation
parameters.description: Inclusive maximum total elevation gain for the activity, in meters.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Inclusive earliest activity start date, based on the activity's local start time, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Inclusive latest activity start date, based on the activity's local start time, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: upperLatitude
parameters.description: Northern latitude boundary of the bounding box for activity start locations, in decimal degrees. Provide all four latitude and longitude boundaries to apply this filter.

parameters.name: rightLongitude
parameters.description: Eastern longitude boundary of the bounding box for activity start locations, in decimal degrees. Provide all four latitude and longitude boundaries to apply this filter.

parameters.name: lowerLatitude
parameters.description: Southern latitude boundary of the bounding box for activity start locations, in decimal degrees. Provide all four latitude and longitude boundaries to apply this filter.

parameters.name: leftLongitude
parameters.description: Western longitude boundary of the bounding box for activity start locations, in decimal degrees. Provide all four latitude and longitude boundaries to apply this filter.

parameters.name: lowerMaxDepth
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on the dive activity's maximum depth, in centimeters.

parameters.name: upperMaxDepth
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on the dive activity's maximum depth, in centimeters.

parameters.name: decoDive
parameters.description: Filter by decompression dive status: true returns decompression dives and false returns activities marked as non-decompression dives. Omit to apply no decompression dive filter.

parameters.name: minElapsedDuration
parameters.description: Inclusive minimum total elapsed activity duration, including paused time, in seconds.

parameters.name: maxElapsedDuration
parameters.description: Inclusive maximum total elapsed activity duration, including paused time, in seconds.

parameters.name: minBottomTime
parameters.description: Inclusive minimum dive bottom time, in seconds.

parameters.name: maxBottomTime
parameters.description: Inclusive maximum dive bottom time, in seconds.

parameters.name: minAvgPower
parameters.description: Inclusive minimum average activity power, in watts.

parameters.name: excludedActivitySubType
parameters.description: Activity subtype keys to exclude. Repeat this query parameter to exclude multiple subtypes.

parameters.name: requiredField
parameters.description: Activity fields that must have a non-null value for an activity to be included. Repeat this query parameter to require multiple fields; all specified fields must be present.

200.description: Returns an array of activity summaries matching the supplied filters and pagination. Returns an empty array when no results are found for the provided query parameters.

400.description: Invalid activity type or subtype: unknown key, activityType identifies a subtype instead of a parent type, activitySubType identifies a parent type instead of a subtype, or activitySubType does not belong to the supplied activityType. Invalid bounding box: when all four coordinates are supplied, latitude must be between -90 and 90 degrees and longitude between -180 and 180 degrees, inclusive. The distance between (upperLatitude, rightLongitude) and (lowerLatitude, leftLongitude) exceeds the maximum distance

hasRunPowerWindData.description: Indicates whether wind data was used to determine running power for the activity; null when wind is not enabled for running power on the device.

isWheelchair.description: Indicates whether the activity was performed in wheelchair mode or includes a wheelchair exercise workout.

specializedWorkoutCategories.description: Specialized category identifiers for the activity's associated workout. Multiple categories may be returned.

items.description: A workout category identifier, such as ATP, ITP, STRENGTH, FBT_ADAPTIVE, or BENCHMARK_ATTEMPT

hasMultiDayActivities.description: Indicates whether the activity is part of an Epic.

personalRecord.description: Indicates whether the activity is a personal record.

gcj02.description: Indicates whether the activity's coordinates use the GCJ-02 coordinate system, commonly used for mapping in China.

runPowerWindDataEnabled.description: Indicates whether the user enabled wind data for running power calculations in the device's training settings.

trimmed.description: Indicates whether the activity has been trimmed to remove part of the original recording.

manualActivity.description: Indicates whether the activity is identified as manually entered rather than recorded by a device.

autoCalcCalories.description: True when calories were calculated because no calorie measurement was available; the estimate uses activity type, user weight, duration, and distance when available.

favorite.description: Indicates whether the user marked their activity as a favorite.

formatId.description: Stored file-format identifier: 1 for tcx, 2 for gpx, 3 for deviceXml, 4 for hst, 5 for axm, 6 for kml, or 7 for fit

formatKey.description: Name corresponding to formatId, such as tcx, gpx, deviceXml, hst, axm, kml, or fit

SensorInfoDTO.description: Information about a sensor or accessory associated with the activity ignoring built-in sensors and the device that recorded the activity.

serialNumber.description: Serial number identifying the sensor or accessory.

sku.description: Product SKU or part number for the accessory, when available, such as a Garmin part number or a Tacx product code.

fitProductNumber.description: Numeric product identifier from the device information.

sourceType.description: Communication source, such as ANT, ANTPLUS or BLUETOOTH_LOW_ENERGY

localDeviceType.description: Built-in device type name, such as WHR for a wrist heart rate sensor. Applicable when sourceType is LOCAL

bodyLocation.description: Location of the sensor on the user's body, expressed as a body location name, when known.

softwareVersion.description: Version of the sensor's internal software, when known.

batteryStatus.description: Qualitative battery condition, such as GOOD, OK, or LOW. Distinct from the numeric batteryLevel percentage.

bleDeviceType.description: Bluetooth Low Energy device type name, such as HEART_RATE or BIKE_TRAINER. Applicable to sensors whose sourceType is BLUETOOTH_LOW_ENERGY.

productName.description: Name of the sensor or accessory product, when available.

If the value is in the closed range 0-99, then a multisport transition reset should be performed in between the legs (record a multisport activity).

stepIndex.description: Zero-based index identifying the step within the workout. Repeat instructions use these indices to identify the step to return to.

name.description: Name of the workout step, when supplied. May be null or blank.

intensity.description: Role or effort classification of the step, such as ACTIVE, WARMUP, COOLDOWN, REST, or RECOVERY.

durationType.description: Condition that ends the step, such as TIME, DISTANCE, REPS, HR_LESS_THAN, HR_GREATER_THAN, OPEN for no fixed duration, and REPEAT_UNTIL_STEPS_CMPLT for a repeat group.

durationValue.description: Value for the step's end condition: seconds for TIME, meters for DISTANCE, or repetition count for REPS. For repeat instructions, this is the stepIndex to return to, not elapsed time. Heart-rate thresholds use percentage of maximum heart rate or bpm + 100; power thresholds use percentage of functional threshold power (FTP) or watts + 1000.

targetType.description: Training target for the step, returned as an uppercase identifier such as HEART_RATE, SPEED, CADENCE, POWER, or SWIM_STROKE. OPEN indicates no specific target. Repeat instructions are interpreted using durationType instead.

targetValue.description: Target selector whose meaning depends on the step type. For speed, heart-rate, cadence, or power zones, 0 selects a custom range defined by targetValueLow and targetValueHigh; a nonzero value selects a zone. For REPEAT_UNTIL_STEPS_CMPLT, this is the repeat count; other repeat types use it as their stopping threshold, such as seconds for REPEAT_UNTIL_TIME or meters for REPEAT_UNTIL_DISTANCE.

targetValueLow.description: Lower bound of a custom target range. Speed is in meters per second. Heart rate uses percentage of maximum heart rate or bpm + 100 (250 means 150 bpm). Power uses percentage of FTP or watts + 1000. Cadence is in revolutions per minute, or steps per minute for running workouts.

targetValueHigh.description: Upper bound of a custom target range, using the same units and encoding as targetValueLow. For a heart-rate target, 270 represents 170 bpm.

UserDailySummaryV2DTO.description:
A user's daily summary. Related fields are grouped together (see each nested object's schema for more details). Unless otherwise noted, the following conventions are observed:

* Dates and timestamps are given as unqualified (no timezone) ISO-8601 strings; durations are given as integer milliseconds.
* Decimal values are rounded to 2 decimal places.
